mapper.select: select s.student_id as loginId, s.student_name as name, s.class_id as classId, c.class_name as className from edu_student s left join edu_classroom c on c.class_id = s.class_id where s.student_id = #{loginId} and s.status = '0' limit 1
select t.teacher_id as loginId, t.teacher_name as name from edu_teacher t where t.teacher_id = #{loginId} and t.status = '0' limit 1
select class_id from edu_classroom where head_teacher_id = #{teacherId} and status = '0' order by class_id
